messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Runtime prod - elevated latency (p95/p99) on route "generate". Alert: latency_spike. Canary traffic ~65% showing degradation. Pager: @oncall

maria: I'm oncall, looking. where's deploy id?

deploy-bot: Deployed by jamal - release/feature-scheduler v2 -> canary rollout 65% (canary-20260317-45). Logs: https://deploys/redwood/canary-45

jamal: rolling back would be my vote. seeing kernel_fallback spikes on canary hosts (nv-k80-*) and batch_wait increased. kernel_fallback_count: 324 -> 1200 in 5m

tim: agreed. prefetch queue depth up, batching window auto-expanded. p50 mostly fine, p99 climbing fast.

maria: set feature flag new_scheduler -> off (kill-switch). doing via FF service now.

sre_lead: Maria, if kill-switch doesn't stabilize in 2m, prepare for rollback. escalate to SEs and notify CS if impact >5% of requests.

maria: FF flipped -> new_scheduler=false. observability shows slight p95 improvement but still above baseline.

jamal: kernel_fallback still rising on subset of hosts, initiating immediate canary->0 traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollback: canary-20260317-45 -> traffic shift to baseline 100%. ETA ~45s.

elaine: prepping customer impact msg. which customers saw noticeable errors/latency?

support-bot: Incident query: top affected orgs by request volume: AcmeCorp (~2% total), BetaApps (~0.7%). No large 5xx surge, mostly elevated latency/timeouts at p99.

tim: capture from kernel logs: 
```
[warning] kernel_fallback: walrus_kmod failed allocate 0x1c0000
[info] batching: window_ms auto-extend -> 70ms (from 20ms)
```

maria: rollback reported as completed. deploy-bot: Rollback successful, canary removed, traffic restored to baseline.

maria: metrics now trending: p99 dropping back toward normal baseline. continuing to monitor for 10m.

sre_lead: nice work. action items: jamal to open root-cause ticket for kernel_fallback, eng-runtime to add circuit-breaker on batch window expansion, ops to run canary replay. CS (elaine) to prepare customer communication if required.

jamal: taking triage and filing ticket now. will include kernel logs and host map.

elaine: drafting customer-facing note; will post to #status-updates in 15m with summary and mitigation steps.

maria: thanks everyone. if stable for 10m we'll close the page. :thumbsup:
